messages.text:
The last change was too broad: it made quoted leading strings look like bare command names during pipeline detection.

I’m tightening only that decision point so quoted literals remain expressions while command arguments still get usable quote handling.

commands.receipt:
failures=2
EXPR "hello world" | split row " " | get 1
REF (0, 'world\n', '')
PORT (1, '', 'parse error\n')
EXPR "hello world" | split column " " | get "column1".0
REF (0, 'hello\n', '')
PORT (1, '', 'parse error\n')
